stem: Find the line passing through the point $(-1, 5)$ with gradient $-1$. Drag the two points so the line is that line.

hints.text: A negative gradient means the line falls as you move right.
The line must pass through the given point. Substitute it into y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) to find where the line meets the y-axis.
Start from y − y₁ = m(x − x₁) with the given gradient and point.
